summary.intent: Land a series of changes in the callisto Rust workspace as separate PRs: a CLI argument change, a docs update (10-minute claim, pre-v1 wording, internal-crate notes, invariant numbering), and a migration of the workspace to Rust edition 2024 with resolver 3.
summary.outcome: The CLI args PR and docs PR were committed and opened after local CI passed. The edition 2024 / resolver 3 migration was completed with local CI exit=0 and committed and rebased. The transcript ends before the push and PR for the edition change.

repo: The workspace uses git worktrees (EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree) with one worktree per PR-sized change.
A full local CI script is run in the background and its exit code is read from the log (exit=0) before committing, rebasing and opening a PR.
Moving to edition 2024 required pinning the rustfmt style edition in rustfmt.toml to avoid formatting churn across the workspace.
Under edition 2024 clippy flagged collapsible-if patterns that were fixed with auto-fix into let-chains.
Tests that mutated env vars with set_var/remove_var needed a change because these are unsafe in edition 2024. They were moved to the temp-env crate, added as a dev-dependency of callisto-graph.
Docs reference invariant numbers, so numbering and cross-references had to be checked when adding internal-crate notes.
The edition migration touched many files across callisto-cli, callisto-graph, callisto-manifests and callisto-model, mostly from migration lints and clippy let-chain fixes.

code.finding: Added temp-env as a dev-dependency to replace unsafe std::env mutation in graph tests.
Style edition is pinned here so the edition 2024 move does not reformat the whole workspace.
Workspace edition flipped to 2024 and resolver set to 3.

workflow: Python helper scripts written to a scratch jobs/tmp dir (docs_internal.py, fix_env.py) were used for bulk edits and then applied and verified in the same step.
Measure the cost of a migration (formatting churn, clippy error counts) before deciding how to handle it, e.g. pin the style edition rather than reformat everything.
Run long CI as a background task with a Monitor and only commit/PR after confirming the exit line.

friction: Find the 10-minute claim and pre-v1 wording was run twice, once before and once after switching worktrees, suggesting the first run was in the wrong worktree.
The edition migration lint fix command was run twice in a row, suggesting a first attempt did not fully apply.
Edition 2024 broke the build in tests that used unsafe env mutation, requiring a dependency and a scripted rewrite.
open_items: Push the edition 2024 / resolver 3 branch and open its PR; the transcript ends after commit and rebase.
The CLI args and docs PRs are open and awaiting review or merge.
